audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side read Skill / Singed / Singed / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed. The packet chart is Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed / Skill, and the mirror audit moved exactly those three rows (Levels 4-5, Level 6, two items) as one group.
audit.why: The content whys already argue the packet's version: whys[3] says proxy pressure locks you under tower, whys[4] says without Hijack your chain cannot catch him, whys[6] says play teamfights instead of the 1v1. Only the tokens disagreed. Sylas 47.32% over 224 games is a losing lane, which the corrected chart reflects and the old one did not.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Singed, row 6 to Skill, as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why and phases[4].why are generic boilerplate that contradict their own rows — phases[4] promises 'the all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way' on a row the packet gives to Singed.
audit.why: Level 6 is Singed's spike, not yours: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so his ultimate is a direct counter to Kingslayer's missing-health heal. Insanity Potion is 100s flat against your 80s Hijack.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to name the real reason each row belongs to Singed — proxy plus grounding at 4-5, anti-heal at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive's GROUNDING is not mentioned anywhere on the page, which is the decisive interaction in this matchup.
audit.why: Grounding shuts off dashes, and BOTH of Sylas's mobility tools are dashes — Kingslayer (W, 400) and Abscond/Abduct (E, 400). Standing in the goo removes his gap-close and his escape simultaneously. Mega Adhesive is 1000 range on 17/16/15/14/13.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[3].why and wants.foe[0]. Also stated the Fling-into-goo root, which Riot's E text spells out.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (W flags and text, E text)

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion is described only as a move-speed steroid. It also makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot text: 'granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.' Sylas's entire sustain is one healing ability, so a permanent poison field carrying anti-heal is a direct answer to it.
audit.corrected: Take the extended trade before his ultimate is up. Once it lands, Kingslayer's missing-health heal is worth roughly half.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] tells the player to trade in Fling's 'his 14-second window'. Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8.
audit.why: At rank 1 the window is 10 seconds, not 14 — a 40% overstatement of the safest gap in the lane. Fling is also only 125 range, far shorter than the page's repeated 'never chase into range' implies.
audit.corrected: Fling is 10s and 125 range; it is not the gate. Mega Adhesive at 1000 range and 17s is.
sources: champ-data/_kits/singed.json (E cd and range, W cd and range)

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull refer to Sylas losing 'no stun'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Abscond/Abduct is a dash plus a recast self-pull; no hardCC flag. The mirror auditor removed the same wording without asserting the negative.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real risk — no shield, no gap-close, and standing in Mega Adhesive.

audit.why: The suspectName 'If Fling' is a sentence-initial 'If' followed by the correct ability name, flagged on edit distance.

notes: The two missingInteractions entries were both genuine and both absent from every field: Mega Adhesive grounds, which disables BOTH of Sylas's dashes at once, and Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, which halves his only sustain. The page had built its whole clock around Fling instead, and got Fling's cooldown wrong by 40% (14s claimed, 10s real) while overstating its 125 range. Two things I could not fix inside the length band and that want a later pass: the 'mid' paragraph still says 'E2 chain for the stun', repeating the E-stun invention the mirror auditor flagged, and report[8].t advises 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — Singed has no healing ability in his kit at all, so that item advice is pointed at nothing.
